definitions.explanation: A payment method where money is automatically withdrawn from a bank account to pay recurring bills such as utilities, insurance, or subscriptions.

examples.japanese: {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}で{支払|しはら}う。
examples.english: I pay by automatic bank transfer.

examples.japanese: {電気代|でんきだい}を{口座振替|こうざふりかえ}にした。
examples.english: I set up my electricity bill for direct debit.

examples.japanese: {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}の{手続|てつづ}きには{届出印|とどけでいん}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A registered seal is required for the direct debit application process.

notes:
A standard payment method in Japan for recurring bills. Most utility companies, insurance providers, and subscription services offer {口座振替|こうざふりかえ} as a payment option. Setting it up typically requires filling out a form at the bank or service provider.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}の{申|もう}し{込|こ}み — direct debit application
- {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}{日|び} — direct debit date
- {口座振替|こうざふりかえ}{依頼書|いらいしょ} — direct debit request form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {振込|ふりこみ} — bank transfer (manual, one-time)
- {引|ひ}き{落|お}とし — automatic deduction (often interchangeable)
- {自動引落|じどうひきおと}し — automatic withdrawal
